{"allowed_envs":["PRIVATE_AI_GATEWAY_ADMIN_TOKEN","ENVOLVR_UPSTREAM_KEY","ENVOLVR_CONTROL_TOKEN","ENVOLVR_CONTROL_ADMIN_TOKEN","ENVOLVR_NEAR_KEY","CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN","ENVOLVR_BACKUP_ACCESS_KEY_ID","ENVOLVR_BACKUP_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"],"docker_compose_file":"# envolvr production: Private AI Gateway plus the envolvr control plane, in one
# dstack TDX VM on Phala Cloud.
#
# Everything that defines behaviour is in this file, so dstack's compose_hash
# (measured into RTMR3) binds it: both source commits, the image digests, the
# gateway config, the upstream pins and the control-plane config. Only secrets
# arrive through encrypted environment variables:
#
#   PRIVATE_AI_GATEWAY_ADMIN_TOKEN   gateway admin API
#   ENVOLVR_CONTROL_TOKEN            gateway -> control plane bearer
#   ENVOLVR_CONTROL_ADMIN_TOKEN      control plane /admin
#   ENVOLVR_UPSTREAM_KEY             RedPill (Phala Cloud Confidential AI) API key
#   ENVOLVR_NEAR_KEY                 NEAR AI Cloud API key
#   CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN             envolvr.xyz zone: Zone:Read, DNS:Edit
#   ENVOLVR_BACKUP_ACCESS_KEY_ID     Backblaze B2 application key, read and write on the
#   ENVOLVR_BACKUP_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY ledger backup bucket only (keyID, applicationKey)
#
#   phala deploy -n envolvr-prod -c compose.yaml -t tdx.large --image dstack-0.5.9 \
#     --no-dev-os --public-logs -e <file with the secrets above>
#
# Build on tdx.large (the gateway compiles Rust at first boot), then resize down;
# the build is cached on the data disk.
#
# Compose does not recreate a container when only an inline config's content
# changes. Bump the -rN suffix of a config whenever its content changes.
#
# Public endpoints: https://api.envolvr.xyz (gateway) and https://auth.envolvr.xyz
# (sign-in, control plane). TLS terminates in the ingress inside this VM; Phala's
# edge only passes the encrypted stream through (DNS TXT
# _dstack-app-address.<domain> = <app-id>:443). The ingress obtains the
# certificates in the VM (Let's Encrypt, DNS-01 via Cloudflare), publishes CAA
# records that pin issuance to its ACME account, and serves evidence at
# /evidences/. The gateway puts the api.envolvr.xyz certificate key into its
# attested keyset, so a client can bind its TLS channel to this workload. No
# other port is published: the Phala URLs, which terminate TLS outside the VM,
# no longer reach the gateway or the control plane.
#
# NEAR AI routes are verified per model enclave by the gateway's Python bridge
# (run with uv, pinned below) against the dstack-verifier sidecar. The verifier
# downloads OS images from download.dstack.org, which lacks the image NEAR's
# GPU enclaves run (dstack-nvidia-0.5.11); os-images preloads it from the
# meta-dstack release. Trust does not rest on the download: the enclave attests
# os_image_hash = sha256(sha256sum.txt), and every boot file is checked against
# that list before the verifier can use it.
#
# The credit ledger (control.db) is copied off the VM to Backblaze B2 every five
# minutes when it changed and on every stop, sealed with a key the dstack KMS
# derives for this app, so only a VM of this app can read a copy. When /data/control.db
# does not exist, the control plane restores the newest copy before it serves,
# and refuses to start if it cannot read the bucket. To restore over an existing
# ledger, point dbPath at a new file (optionally pinning backup.restoreKey).
#
# Receipt anchoring: the gateway posts the digest of every signed receipt to the
# control plane (receipt_log). In fixed 10-minute slots the control plane
# anchors a Merkle root of the slot's digests to ReceiptAnchor on Robinhood
# Chain, signed with a key the dstack KMS derives for this app, and serves each
# receipt's inclusion proof at https://auth.envolvr.xyz/receipts/<digest>/proof.
# The owner registers that key's address (logged at start) with setAnchorer.
#
# Sanctions screening: every wallet is checked against the Chainalysis
# sanctions oracle, read on Ethereum and Arbitrum One through independent RPC
# operators (it is not on Robinhood Chain yet), at sign-in, on every deposit
# (a match is held, not credited) and daily while the wallet is active.

services:
  gateway:
    image: docker.io/dstacktee/git-launcher@sha256:4437dce18ec713b0991d34bd926d324966b1a0b90fad485b8ddb3f4ed2af138b
    command: ["/etc/git-launcher/gateway.conf"]
    configs:
      - source: gateway-pin-r5
        target: /etc/git-launcher/gateway.conf
      - source: run-gateway-r1
        target: /etc/envolvr/run-gateway.sh
      - source: gateway-config-r4
        target: /etc/private-ai-gateway/gateway.config.json
      - source: gateway-upstreams-r2
        target: /etc/private-ai-gateway/upstreams.seed.json
    environment:
      PRIVATE_AI_GATEWAY_CONFIG_PATH: /etc/private-ai-gateway/gateway.config.json
      PRIVATE_AI_GATEWAY_CACHE_DIR: /var/lib/private-ai-gateway/cache
      DSTACK_VERIFIER_URL: http://dstack-verifier:8080
      # The provider-verifier bridge: a managed CPython and the locked
      # dependencies (uv.lock), cached on the state volume.
      UV_PYTHON: "3.14"
      UV_PYTHON_PREFERENCE: only-managed
      UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR: /var/lib/private-ai-gateway/cache/uv/python
      UV_CACHE_DIR: /var/lib/private-ai-gateway/cache/uv/cache
      UV_FROZEN: "1"
    volumes:
      - gateway-checkout:/var/lib/git-launcher
      - gateway-state:/var/lib/private-ai-gateway
      - ingress-evidences:/evidences:ro
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
    depends_on:
      - control
      - dstack-verifier
      - ingress
    restart: unless-stopped

  ingress:
    image: ghcr.io/dstack-tee/dstack-ingress:2.6@sha256:c212abb7bedec4d7b54a82bcf9972e58e39a4757cc811faeb6017eee6c0673b0
    # The logs are public (--public-logs), so they must not carry traffic
    # metadata. The stock ingress logs every connection (time, domain, bytes,
    # duration) and every evidence request; both are turned off here, before
    # the stock entrypoint writes its haproxy config, and the container refuses
    # to start if either change did not apply. Startup warnings and errors
    # still reach the log.
    entrypoint:
      - bash
      - -c
      - |
        set -eu
        sed -i -e 's/^    log     global$$/    no log/' -e '/^    option  tcplog$$/d' /scripts/haproxy-lib.sh
        sed -i 's|-l /dev/stderr|-l /dev/null|' /scripts/evidence-lib.sh
        grep -q '^    no log$$' /scripts/haproxy-lib.sh
        grep -q -- '-l /dev/null' /scripts/evidence-lib.sh
        if grep -q 'option  tcplog' /scripts/haproxy-lib.sh; then echo "connection logging still on" >&2; exit 1; fi
        exec /scripts/entrypoint.sh "$$@"
      - ingress
    command: ["haproxy", "-W", "-f", "/etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg"]
    ports:
      - "443:443"
    environment:
      DNS_PROVIDER: cloudflare
      CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:?set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}
      GATEWAY_DOMAIN: gateway.dstack-pha-prod5.phala.network
      SET_CAA: "true"
      DOMAINS: |
        api.envolvr.xyz
        auth.envolvr.xyz
      ROUTING_MAP: |
        api.envolvr.xyz=gateway:8086
        auth.envolvr.xyz=control:8787
    volumes:
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
      - ingress-letsencrypt:/etc/letsencrypt
      - ingress-evidences:/evidences
    restart: unless-stopped

  dstack-verifier:
    image: ghcr.io/dstack-tee/dstack-verifier@sha256:3710ec5c408a0d04e408668905152cc8c972396c0fa3d942158c5e67e969628d
    volumes:
      - verifier-cache:/tmp/dstack-verifier/cache
    depends_on:
      os-images:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    restart: unless-stopped

  os-images:
    image: docker.io/library/node:24-bookworm@sha256:64af3819f9275802414d7cdc38c27e9d82bd564dec4d4da87d008255d36c63b4
    command:
      - bash
      - -c
      - |
        set -euo pipefail
        HASH=a6eafc5f007f642d8ea90c7fa8881f1e6715720ccb531941a28218f4f26d7b02
        URL=https://github.com/Dstack-TEE/meta-dstack/releases/download/v0.5.11/dstack-nvidia-0.5.11.tar.gz
        DEST=/cache/images/$$HASH
        valid() { [ "$$(sha256sum "$$1/sha256sum.txt" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$$HASH" ] && (cd "$$1" && sha256sum -c --quiet sha256sum.txt); }
        if [ -f "$$DEST/sha256sum.txt" ] && valid "$$DEST"; then echo "dstack-nvidia-0.5.11 present"; exit 0; fi
        mkdir -p /cache/images
        rm -rf /cache/images/.preload.*
        TMP=$$(mktemp -d /cache/images/.preload.XXXXXX)
        curl -fsSL --retry 3 "$$URL" | tar -xz -C "$$TMP" --strip-components=1 \
          dstack-nvidia-0.5.11/sha256sum.txt dstack-nvidia-0.5.11/bzImage dstack-nvidia-0.5.11/initramfs.cpio.gz \
          dstack-nvidia-0.5.11/ovmf.fd dstack-nvidia-0.5.11/metadata.json
        valid "$$TMP" || { echo "dstack-nvidia-0.5.11 failed its hash check" >&2; rm -rf "$$TMP"; exit 1; }
        rm -rf "$$DEST"
        mv "$$TMP" "$$DEST"
        echo "dstack-nvidia-0.5.11 preloaded"
    volumes:
      - verifier-cache:/cache
    restart: "no"

  control:
    image: docker.io/library/node:24-bookworm@sha256:64af3819f9275802414d7cdc38c27e9d82bd564dec4d4da87d008255d36c63b4
    command:
      - sh
      - -c
      - |
        set -eu
        COMMIT=b47b15da1ebc6a59b1c2a0736a53b963ebf94efb
        [ -d /opt/envolvr/.git ] || git clone --quiet --no-checkout https://github.com/envolvr/envolvr.git /opt/envolvr
        cd /opt/envolvr
        git fetch --quiet origin
        git checkout --quiet --force "$$COMMIT"
        git clean -fdxq -e control/node_modules
        [ "$$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$$COMMIT" ]
        cd control
        npx --yes pnpm@10.13.1 install --frozen-lockfile --prod
        exec node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/main.ts
    configs:
      - source: control-config-r8
        target: /etc/envolvr/control.json
    environment:
      CONTROL_CONFIG: /etc/envolvr/control.json
      CONTROL_TOKEN: ${ENVOLVR_CONTROL_TOKEN:?set ENVOLVR_CONTROL_TOKEN}
      ADMIN_TOKEN: ${ENVOLVR_CONTROL_ADMIN_TOKEN:?set ENVOLVR_CONTROL_ADMIN_TOKEN}
      BACKUP_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${ENVOLVR_BACKUP_ACCESS_KEY_ID:?set ENVOLVR_BACKUP_ACCESS_KEY_ID}
      BACKUP_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${ENVOLVR_BACKUP_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:?set ENVOLVR_BACKUP_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}
    volumes:
      - control-data:/data
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
    # Time to finish in-flight requests and upload the final ledger copy.
    stop_grace_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

configs:
  gateway-pin-r5:
    content: |
      REPO_URL=https://github.com/envolvr/private-ai-gateway.git
      COMMIT_SHA=adc714c3bf1288c471ad558b290976eb5ec45027
      WORK_DIR=/var/lib/git-launcher/private-ai-gateway
      INSTALL_CMD=dpkg --configure -a && apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc libc6-dev curl ca-certificates && curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o /tmp/uv.tar.gz https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/download/0.12.18/uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz && echo '89eadd7c76fc063887959510d5ba0ab1264dfd5f1143b925ddb73021a40acf16  /tmp/uv.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c - && tar -xzf /tmp/uv.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin --strip-components=1 uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/uv && uv sync --frozen --no-dev
      RUN_CMD=bash /etc/envolvr/run-gateway.sh

  # Starts the gateway (the repo's entrypoint.sh: build, then exec) once the
  # ingress holds its certificate, and restarts it when a renewal changes that
  # certificate, so the attested keyset always carries the key being served.
  run-gateway-r1:
    content: |
      set -u
      CERT=/evidences/cert-api.envolvr.xyz.pem
      PID=
      trap '[ -n "$$PID" ] && kill "$$PID" 2>/dev/null; wait; exit 0' TERM INT
      until [ -s "$$CERT" ]; do echo "[run-gateway] waiting for $$CERT" >&2; sleep 10; done
      while true; do
        SUM=$$(sha256sum "$$CERT")
        bash entrypoint.sh &
        PID=$$!
        while kill -0 "$$PID" 2>/dev/null; do
          sleep 30
          if [ "$$(sha256sum "$$CERT" 2>/dev/null)" != "$$SUM" ]; then
            echo "[run-gateway] certificate changed; restarting the gateway" >&2
            kill "$$PID" 2>/dev/null
            break
          fi
        done
        wait "$$PID"
        echo "[run-gateway] gateway exited ($$?); restarting in 5 s" >&2
        sleep 5
      done

  # state_dir holds the live upstream config, sessions and receipts. It moves
  # to a fresh directory when the upstream seed must apply again; the Rust
  # build cache (PRIVATE_AI_GATEWAY_CACHE_DIR) stays where it is.
  gateway-config-r4:
    content: |
      {
        "bind": "0.0.0.0:8086",
        "state_dir": "/var/lib/private-ai-gateway/state-r2",
        "upstream_config_seed_path": "/etc/private-ai-gateway/upstreams.seed.json",
        "admin_token": "${PRIVATE_AI_GATEWAY_ADMIN_TOKEN:?set PRIVATE_AI_GATEWAY_ADMIN_TOKEN}",
        "dstack_endpoint": "unix:/var/run/dstack.sock",
        "middleware": {
          "control_url": "http://control:8787",
          "control_token": "${ENVOLVR_CONTROL_TOKEN:?set ENVOLVR_CONTROL_TOKEN}"
        },
        "receipt_log": {
          "url": "http://control:8787/receipts",
          "bearer_token": "${ENVOLVR_CONTROL_TOKEN:?set ENVOLVR_CONTROL_TOKEN}"
        },
        "tls": {
          "domain_certificates": [
            { "domain": "api.envolvr.xyz", "certificate_path": "/evidences/cert-api.envolvr.xyz.pem" }
          ]
        }
      }

  # Seeds the gateway's upstream config when its state_dir has none. API keys
  # arrive only as encrypted env, decrypted inside the VM; do not send them
  # through the admin API, whose TLS ends at Phala's ingress.
  gateway-upstreams-r2:
    content: |
      [
        {
          "name": "redpill",
          "provider": "aci-service",
          "base_url": "https://api.redpill.ai",
          "models": {
            "z-ai/glm-5.3": "z-ai/glm-5.3",
            "qwen/qwen3.8-27b": "qwen/qwen3.8-27b"
          },
          "bearer_token": "${ENVOLVR_UPSTREAM_KEY:?set ENVOLVR_UPSTREAM_KEY}",
          "accepted_subjects": ["app-id:0xfdb7a14e5a6675f752e2cb69c9067a98ca402918"],
          "accepted_dstack_kms_root_public_keys": ["0334c76e0c3f52ec64cbf9bbf5c910c272330166fd656c0a86bb330963e46910e1"]
        },
        {
          "name": "near-ai",
          "provider": "near-ai",
          "base_url": "https://cloud-api.near.ai",
          "models": {
            "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash": "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash",
            "qwen/qwen3.8-27b": "Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B",
            "qwen/qwen3.6-35b-a3b": "Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8"
          },
          "bearer_token": "${ENVOLVR_NEAR_KEY:?set ENVOLVR_NEAR_KEY}",
          "verifier_request_timeout_seconds": 300,
          "read_timeout_seconds": 120
        }
      ]

  control-config-r8:
    content: |
      {
        "port": 8787,
        "dbPath": "/data/control.db",
        "marginBps": 0,
        "depositFeeBps": 500,
        "corsOrigins": ["https://envolvr.xyz"],
        "minAvailableMicros": 1000,
        "models": {
          "z-ai/glm-5.3": { "routes": [
            { "upstream": "redpill", "inputCostPerToken": "0.0000014", "outputCostPerToken": "0.0000044" }
          ] },
          "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash": { "routes": [
            { "upstream": "near-ai", "inputCostPerToken": "0.00000015", "outputCostPerToken": "0.0000005", "endpoints": ["/v1/chat/completions"] }
          ] },
          "qwen/qwen3.8-27b": { "routes": [
            { "upstream": "redpill", "inputCostPerToken": "0.00000024", "outputCostPerToken": "0.0000025" },
            { "upstream": "near-ai", "inputCostPerToken": "0.00000044", "outputCostPerToken": "0.0000033", "endpoints": ["/v1/chat/completions"], "optIn": true }
          ] },
          "qwen/qwen3.6-35b-a3b": { "routes": [
            { "upstream": "near-ai", "inputCostPerToken": "0.00000017", "outputCostPerToken": "0.0000011", "endpoints": ["/v1/chat/completions"] }

        "chain": {
          "rpcUrl": "https://rpc.testnet.chain.robinhood.com/rpc",
          "stakingAllowance": "0xFA4296E49055185aD188fd64c9af28F7Db1135F4",

","features":["kms","tproxy-net"],"gateway_enabled":true,"kms_enabled":true,"local_key_provider_enabled":false,"manifest_version":2,"name":"","no_instance_id":false,"pre_launch_script":"#!/bin/bash
echo "----------------------------------------------"
echo "Running Phala Cloud Pre-Launch Script v0.0.20"
echo "----------------------------------------------"
set -e

# Function: notify host

notify_host() {
    if command -v dstack-util >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        dstack-util notify-host -e "$1" -d "$2"
    else
        tdxctl notify-host -e "$1" -d "$2"
    fi
}

notify_host_hoot_info() {
    notify_host "boot.progress" "$1"
}

notify_host_hoot_error() {
    notify_host "boot.error" "$1"
}

# Function: Perform Docker cleanup
perform_cleanup() {
    echo "Pruning unused images"
    docker image prune -af
    echo "Pruning unused volumes"
    docker volume prune -f
    notify_host_hoot_info "docker cleanup completed"
}

# Function: Check Docker login status without exposing credentials
check_docker_login() {
    local registry="${1-}"

    # When registry is specified, check auth entry for that registry in Docker config
    if [[ -n "$registry" ]]; then
        local docker_config_path="${DOCKER_CONFIG:-${HOME:-}/.docker}/config.json"
        if [[ -f "$docker_config_path" ]] && grep -q "$registry" "$docker_config_path"; then
            return 0
        else
            return 1
        fi
    fi

    # Fallback check when no explicit registry is provided
    if docker info 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Username"; then
        return 0
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function: print the SHA256 fingerprint of every authorized key
#
# Output matches `ssh-keygen -lf` and the fingerprints GitHub and Phala Cloud
# display, so an operator can match the boot log against the account's key list.
# The guest image ships neither ssh-keygen nor a base64 applet (BusyBox has
# base32 only), so openssl does both the decode and the digest.
print_authorized_key_fingerprints() {
    local file="$1"
    if ! command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "openssl not available; skipping SSH key fingerprints"
        return 0
    fi

    # Locals start unset under bash; initialize so set -u (inherited from
    # dstack app-compose.sh source) does not trip the read loop guard.
    local key_type="" blob="" comment="" decoded_bytes="" fingerprint=""
    # `|| [[ -n "$key_type" ]]` keeps the final line when the file does not end
    # with a newline; read returns non-zero there but still fills the variables.
    while read -r key_type blob comment || [[ -n "$key_type" ]]; do
        if [[ -z "$blob" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        # openssl exits 0 on undecodable input and emits nothing, which would
        # otherwise print the SHA256 of the empty string as a real fingerprint.
        decoded_bytes=$(printf '%s' "$blob" | openssl base64 -d -A 2>/dev/null | wc -c || true)
        if [[ "$decoded_bytes" -eq 0 ]]; then
            echo "  $key_type <unreadable key>"
            continue
        fi
        fingerprint=$(printf '%s' "$blob" | openssl base64 -d -A 2>/dev/null | openssl dgst -sha256 -binary 2>/dev/null | openssl base64 -A 2>/dev/null | tr -d '=' || true)
        echo "  $key_type SHA256:$fingerprint"
    done < "$file"
}

# Main logic starts here
echo "Starting login process..."

# Optional env vars below use ${VAR-} / ${VAR:-} so this script stays safe when
# app-compose.sh sources it under `set -euo pipefail` without registry/SSH/root
# credentials set. Bare "$VAR" throws "unbound variable" under nounset.
DOCKER_REGISTRY_TARGET="${DSTACK_DOCKER_REGISTRY:-docker.io}"

# Check if Docker credentials exist
if [[ -n "${DSTACK_DOCKER_USERNAME-}" && -n "${DSTACK_DOCKER_PASSWORD-}" ]]; then
    echo "Docker credentials found"
    echo "Target Docker registry: $DOCKER_REGISTRY_TARGET"

    # Check if already logged in
    if check_docker_login "${DSTACK_DOCKER_REGISTRY-}"; then
        echo "Already logged in to Docker registry: $DOCKER_REGISTRY_TARGET"
    else
        echo "Logging in to Docker registry: $DOCKER_REGISTRY_TARGET"
        # Login without exposing password in process list
        if [[ -n "${DSTACK_DOCKER_REGISTRY-}" ]]; then
            if ! echo "$DSTACK_DOCKER_PASSWORD" | docker login -u "$DSTACK_DOCKER_USERNAME" --password-stdin "$DSTACK_DOCKER_REGISTRY"; then
                echo "Docker login failed: $DOCKER_REGISTRY_TARGET"
                notify_host_hoot_error "docker login failed"
                exit 1
            fi
        elif ! echo "$DSTACK_DOCKER_PASSWORD" | docker login -u "$DSTACK_DOCKER_USERNAME" --password-stdin; then
            echo "Docker login failed: $DOCKER_REGISTRY_TARGET"
            notify_host_hoot_error "docker login failed"
            exit 1
        fi
        echo "Docker login successful: $DOCKER_REGISTRY_TARGET"
    fi
# Check if AWS ECR credentials exist
elif [[ -n "${DSTACK_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID-}" && -n "${DSTACK_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY-}" && -n "${DSTACK_AWS_REGION-}" && -n "${DSTACK_AWS_ECR_REGISTRY-}" ]]; then
    echo "AWS ECR credentials found"

    # Check if AWS CLI is installed
    if [ ! -f "./aws/dist/aws" ]; then
        notify_host_hoot_info "awscli not installed, installing..."
        echo "AWS CLI not installed, installing..."
        if ! curl "https://awscli.amazonaws.com/awscli-exe-linux-x86_64-2.24.14.zip" -o "awscliv2.zip"; then
            echo "AWS CLI download failed"
            notify_host_hoot_error "awscli install failed"
